# Approval Card Contract

This is the shared JSON shape between the AgentNick backend and the frontend dashboard.
Every approval card returned by `stage_approval_card` follows this structure.

## Schema

```json
{
  "card_id": "string, unique per card (UUID, generated by stage_approval_card)",
  "scenario_type": "trial_cancellation | broadband_tariff | card_promo | hobby_registration",
  "title": "string, short human-readable headline",
  "summary": "string, 1-2 sentence explanation of what triggered this card",
  "computed_savings_gbp": "number or null, if applicable",
  "action": {
    "type": "email | action_url",
    "email_payload": {
      "to": "string",
      "subject": "string",
      "body": "string"
    },
    "action_url": "string or null"
  },
  "status": "pending | approved | rejected"
}
```

Note: whether a card gets created at all (i.e. whether a savings amount is "worth" surfacing)
is decided upstream, before `stage_approval_card` is called, using the threshold system
(see `tools/interfaces.py` — `ThresholdConfig`, `resolve_threshold`, `meets_threshold`).
The card itself carries no threshold metadata.

## Example — Trial cancellation (email action)

```json
{
  "card_id": "card_001",
  "scenario_type": "trial_cancellation",
  "title": "Cancel ExampleStreaming before you're billed",
  "summary": "Your free trial ends 2026-09-02. Cancel now to avoid a £12.99 charge.",
  "computed_savings_gbp": 12.99,
  "action": {
    "type": "email",
    "email_payload": {
      "to": "support@examplestreaming.com",
      "subject": "Cancel my subscription",
      "body": "Please cancel my ExampleStreaming trial effective immediately."
    },
    "action_url": null
  },
  "status": "pending"
}
```

## Example — Broadband tariff (link-out action)

```json
{
  "card_id": "card_002",
  "scenario_type": "broadband_tariff",
  "title": "Your ExampleISP contract is ending — switch and save",
  "summary": "Renewal price rises to £65/mo. RivalISP offers the same 150Mbps for £38/mo.",
  "computed_savings_gbp": 304.00,
  "action": {
    "type": "action_url",
    "email_payload": null,
    "action_url": "https://example-isp-retention-portal.test/account"
  },
  "status": "pending"
}
```

## Action tier rule

- `email`: used when the action can be completed without login (cancellations, notifications).
- `action_url`: used when the action requires account authentication (switching provider,
  balance transfer, portal-based enrollment). The agent has already done the noticing,
  comparing, and deciding — the user's remaining step is one click to the correct destination.

## Threshold settings (separate from the approval card itself)

User-configurable via the settings screen. Three-tier fallback:

1. **System default** — `ThresholdConfig(mode=OR, min_savings_gbp=15.0, min_savings_pct=10.0)`
2. **User global default** — user's own single OR-based override, applies to all scenarios
3. **Per-scenario override** — user can toggle a specific scenario to number-only or
   percent-only mode with its own values (backend-supported; not surfaced in the MVP
   settings screen)

See `tools/interfaces.py` for `ThresholdConfig`, `UserThresholdSettings`, `ResolvedThreshold`,
`resolve_threshold()`, and `meets_threshold()`.
